The writer's note about it, in their words: r/WarriorCats 的提问帖。我刚开始读 Darktail’s Judgment，想问 Darkpaw 在月亮石那一段，还想说说我的看法。
The post (Reddit 提问帖):
<<<
I’m on the early chapters of Darktail’s Judgment, and I get a little bit confused about why StarClan didn’t show up when Darkpaw was at the moonstone and he got really miserable and furious about it.

Ravenpaw said StarClan had travelled with the Clans and left the forest sky, and it would be hard / not worth it to get back here for a distant little kittypet who wants to join the Clans. But it was mentioned in the book that it was a overcast day, so without the moonlight it makes sense that they couldn’t reach StarClan back then when the Clans were still in the forest. (Could someone tell me if there was a similar case in the other books that the night sky’s cloudy when a cat was at the Moonstone? Or do StarClan have the power to clear the clouds if they want to communicate?)

And Darkpaw didn’t try again on a clear day; he just chose to transform himself into Darktail👿 instead.
>>>

A reader replied: "So you're asking why StarClan didn't answer Darkpaw at the Moonstone. Ravenpaw said they'd left the forest sky, but you wonder if the cloudy night was the real reason, and whether StarClan can clear clouds or other cats had cloudy Moonstone visits."
The tutor's reading of what the post is really about: 为什么星族在月亮石没有出现？作者想听听大家的解释，并问：其他书里有没有阴天的先例，星族能不能拨开云层？
The writer says that is not quite it: "不完全是，我主要想问星族为什么不回应他，阴天只是我猜的原因。"

No praise, no filler.
If what the writer said is a point the post never states, give newSpot: where it belongs (exact words of the post it should follow or replace), the problem (Simplified Chinese (as used in mainland China)), and the reading (Simplified Chinese (as used in mainland China), what they mean). Else null.
gist: the post's real point in one Simplified Chinese (as used in mainland China) sentence.

result.text: {"reply":"好，这下重点就清楚了：你真正想问的是星族为什么不回应Darkpaw，阴天只是你的猜测。帖子开头其实提到了这个困惑，但后面的阴天推测写得很详细，读者很容易把它当成核心问题，所以你回复的那位读者才会理解偏了。下面我们一段一段看看，怎样把重点说得更直接。","gist":"发帖人真正想问的是星族为什么没有回应Darkpaw，阴天只是自己的猜测，并非核心问题。","newSpot":{"after":"I get a little bit confused about why StarClan didn't show up when Darkpaw was at the moonstone and he got really miserable and furious about it.","problem":"帖子开头提出了疑问，但没有说明阴天只是猜测，后面的阴天推测写得很具体，读者容易误以为阴天就是要问的重点。","reading":"建议在这里直接点明：我真正想问的是星族为什么不回应他，阴天只是我自己的猜测，并不确定是不是原因。"}}
